notes: Base URL must be https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/cursor (not /api/v1). The dedicated path normalizes Cursor's flat tool format.
Paste an OpenRouter key (sk-or-...) into Cursor Settings → Models → OpenAI API Key. Do not put the key in settings.json.
Add each model id exactly as listed. Router aliases need a ~ prefix (e.g. ~moonshotai/kimi-latest); our pins do not.
Tab completions always use Cursor-native models. Composer / Auto may ignore BYOK — pick a listed OpenRouter id in the model picker.
Do not leave the OpenAI override on while using Composer; Cursor returns 'This model does not support custom API keys'.
